Featured System • Weather Intelligence & Real-Time GIS

Project Zephyr

Live on Render

A real-time meteorological intelligence and geospatial monitoring system. Integrates live Open-Meteo APIs, ECMWF 50-member ensemble uncertainty calculations, and RainViewer Doppler radar feeds to deliver live precipitation tracking, animated vector wind-flow fields, dual-axis 24-hour predictive visualizations, automated weather risk scores (0–100), and an AI-ready forecast summary.

Featured Project • Minimalist Literary Journal & Reader Engine

Shiori (栞)

栞

A Japanese Wabi-Sabi inspired digital repository and reading engine for serialized literature, haiku sequences (詩歌 / Uta), and introspective zen reflections (随筆 / Zuihitsu). Features a distraction-free offline-first architecture with chapter directories, fluid typography controls (A−/A+), local storage draft synchronization, JSON data export/import, and an organic Washi paper and Sumi ink aesthetic with an animated Hanko stamp splash reveal.

JavaScript (ES6+) Tailwind CSS Offline-First / LocalStorage Reading Engine (A−/A+) JSON Data Pipeline Wabi-Sabi UI

01 / Monogatari Engine

02 / Poetry & Zen Reflections

03 / Studio & Persistence

In-browser drafting studio with local storage persistence and full JSON export/import portability.
